    def nextGen(self):
        at:int = 0

        te:int = 0 
        se:int = 0
        maxval:int = 0
        atX:int = 0
        atY:int = 0
        newCells = [[0] * size] * size

        for atX in range(1, size):
            for atY in range(1, size):
                newCells[at] = self.rules[self.cells[atX-1][atY-1]+
                        self.cells[atX  ][atY-1]+
                        self.cells[atX+1][atY-1]+
                        self.cells[atX-1][atY  ]+
                        self.cells[atX  ][atY  ]+
                        self.cells[atX+1][atY  ]+
                        self.cells[atX-1][atY+1]+
                        self.cells[atX  ][atY+1]+
                        self.cells[atX+1][atY+1]]
                se += (abs(newCells[atX-1][atY]-newCells[atX][atY])+
                    abs(newCells[atX][atY-1]-newCells[atX][atY]))
                te += abs(newCells[atX][atY]-self.cells[atX][atY])
                maxval = max(maxval, newCells[atX][atY])

        if (maxval > 0):

            temporalEntropy = (temporalEntropy*5+float(te)/(size[0]-2)/maxval)/6
            spatialEntropy = (spatialEntropy*5+float(se)/(size[0]-2)/maxval)/6
        else:
            # otherwise, add zero to the averages
            temporalEntropy = temporalEntropy*5/6
            spatialEntropy = spatialEntropy*5/6

PROCEDURE WriteSegment(ForSegment : SegmentRec);
VAR
  Max, Adj : INTEGER;
BEGIN
  Max:=RangeVal[CurrentRange]*10;
  Adj:=RangeVal[CurrentRange]*2;
  WITH ForSegment DO BEGIN
    IF (Range1<Max) AND (Range2<Max) THEN BEGIN
      IF (Range1>1310) OR (Range2>1310) THEN BEGIN
        Draw(Trunc(Range1*(ASin[Bear1]-128.0)/Adj)+160,
          50-Trunc(Range1*(ACos[Bear1]-128.0)/Adj),
          Trunc(Range2*(ASin[Bear2]-128.0)/Adj)+160,
          50-Trunc(Range2*(ACos[Bear2]-128.0)/Adj),Pen);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        Draw(Range1*(ASin[Bear1]-128) div Adj+160,
          50-Range1*(ACos[Bear1]-128) div Adj,
          Range2*(ASin[Bear2]-128) div Adj+160,
          50-Range2*(ACos[Bear2]-128) div Adj,Pen);
      END; (* IF *)
    END; (* IF *)
  END; (* WITH *)
END; (* WriteSegment *)

member this.Process(samples: float[]) : APTLine list =
/ Process a block of demodulated samples
Calls: 3 in this module (Reset, ExtractLine, ProcessSample)
Called by: 3 in this module (Create, Process, ExtractLine)

    member this.Process(samples: float[]) : APTLine list =
        let lines = ResizeArray<APTLine>()

        for i in 0 .. samples.Length - 1 do
            match this.State with
            | WaitingForSync ->
                let (foundA, foundB, confidence) = this.SyncDetector.ProcessSample(samples.[i])
                if foundA || foundB then
                    this.State <- CollectingLine
                    this.LineBufferIndex <- 0
                    this.SyncConfidence <- confidence
                    this.LastSyncType <- if foundA then 'A' else 'B'

            | CollectingLine ->
                if this.LineBufferIndex < this.SamplesPerLine then
                    this.LineBuffer.[this.LineBufferIndex] <- samples.[i]
                    this.LineBufferIndex <- this.LineBufferIndex + 1

                    // Also check for sync (to track timing)
                    let (foundA, foundB, confidence) = this.SyncDetector.ProcessSample(samples.[i])
                    if (foundA || foundB) && confidence > this.SyncConfidence then
                        this.SyncConfidence <- confidence

                    if this.LineBufferIndex >= this.SamplesPerLine then
                        this.State <- LineComplete
                else
                    this.State <- LineComplete

            | LineComplete ->
                // Extract the line
                match this.ExtractLine() with
                | Some line ->
                    lines.Add(line)
                    this.LinesDecoded <- this.LinesDecoded + 1
                | None -> ()

                // Reset for next line
                this.CurrentLineNumber <- this.CurrentLineNumber + 1
                this.State <- WaitingForSync

        lines |> List.ofSeq

member private this.Correlate(pattern: float[], startIndex: int) : float =
/ Correlate buffer with sync pattern

    member private this.Correlate(pattern: float[], startIndex: int) : float =
        let mutable sum = 0.0
        let mutable energy = 0.0

        for i in 0 .. pattern.Length - 1 do
            let bufIdx = (startIndex + i) % this.Buffer.Length
            sum <- sum + this.Buffer.[bufIdx] * pattern.[i]
            energy <- energy + this.Buffer.[bufIdx] * this.Buffer.[bufIdx]

        let normEnergy = sqrt energy
        if normEnergy > 0.001 then
            sum / (normEnergy * sqrt (float pattern.Length))
        else
            0.0

/ Add sample and check for sync

    member this.ProcessSample(sample: float) : (bool * bool * float) =
        // Add to circular buffer
        this.Buffer.[this.BufferIndex] <- sample
        let searchIndex = (this.BufferIndex - this.SyncAPattern.Length + 1 + this.Buffer.Length) % this.Buffer.Length

        // Check correlations
        let corrA = this.Correlate(this.SyncAPattern, searchIndex)
        let corrB = this.Correlate(this.SyncBPattern, searchIndex)

        this.BufferIndex <- (this.BufferIndex + 1) % this.Buffer.Length

        let foundA = abs corrA > this.Threshold
        let foundB = abs corrB > this.Threshold

        (foundA, foundB, max (abs corrA) (abs corrB))

    let compress (data: byte[]) (windowSize: int) (minMatch: int) : byte[] =
        if data.Length = 0 then
            [||]
        else
            let output = ResizeArray<byte>()
            let mutable pos = 0

            while pos < data.Length do
                let mutable bestOffset = 0
                let mutable bestLength = 0

                // Search for match in window
                let windowStart = max 0 (pos - windowSize)
                for i in windowStart .. pos - 1 do
                    let mutable length = 0
                    while pos + length < data.Length &&
                          length < 255 &&
                          data.[i + length] = data.[pos + length] do
                        length <- length + 1

                    if length >= minMatch && length > bestLength then
                        bestLength <- length
                        bestOffset <- pos - i

                if bestLength >= minMatch then
                    // Output match: FLAG + OFFSET + LENGTH
                    output.Add(0xFFuy)  // Match flag
                    output.Add(byte bestOffset)
                    output.Add(byte bestLength)
                    pos <- pos + bestLength
                else
                    // Output literal
                    if data.[pos] = 0xFFuy then
                        output.Add(0xFFuy)
                        output.Add(0uy)  // Literal 0xFF marker
                        output.Add(data.[pos])
                    else
                        output.Add(data.[pos])
                    pos <- pos + 1

            output.ToArray()

text:

let saveCompressed (image: HackRF.NOAA.CoreTypes.APTImage) (filename: string) (useCompression: bool) =
/ Save APT image to compressed file
Calls: 1 in this module (compressImage) and 1 in CoreTypes (Write)
Called by: 1 in Program (private)

    let saveCompressed (image: HackRF.NOAA.CoreTypes.APTImage) (filename: string) (useCompression: bool) =
        use stream = File.Create(filename)
        use writer = new BinaryWriter(stream)

        // Magic
        writer.Write(magic)

        // Header
        let satByte =
            match image.Satellite with
            | HackRF.NOAA.CoreTypes.NOAA15 -> 0uy
            | HackRF.NOAA.CoreTypes.NOAA18 -> 1uy
            | HackRF.NOAA.CoreTypes.NOAA19 -> 2uy

        let height = Array2D.length1 image.ChannelAData
        let width = Array2D.length2 image.ChannelAData

        writer.Write(1uy)  // Version
        writer.Write(satByte)
        writer.Write(width)
        writer.Write(height)
        writer.Write(image.StartTime.ToFileTimeUtc())
        writer.Write(image.EndTime.ToFileTimeUtc())
        writer.Write(if useCompression then 1uy else 0uy)
        writer.Write(0uy)  // Flags

        // Channel A data
        if useCompression then
            let compressed = ImageRLE.compressImage image.ChannelAData
            writer.Write(compressed.Length)
            writer.Write(compressed)
        else
            for y in 0 .. height - 1 do
                for x in 0 .. width - 1 do
                    writer.Write(image.ChannelAData.[y, x])

        // Channel B data
        if useCompression then
            let compressed = ImageRLE.compressImage image.ChannelBData
            writer.Write(compressed.Length)
            writer.Write(compressed)
        else
            for y in 0 .. height - 1 do
                for x in 0 .. width - 1 do
                    writer.Write(image.ChannelBData.[y, x])

let generateWindow (windowType: WindowType) (length: int) : float[] =
/ Generate window coefficients
Calls: 4 in this module (Create, Create, Create, Create)

let generateWindow (windowType: WindowType) (length: int) : float[] =
    let n = float length
    match windowType with
    | Rectangular ->
        Array.create length 1.0

    | Hamming ->
        Array.init length (fun i ->
            0.54 - 0.46 * cos (2.0 * Math.PI * float i / (n - 1.0)))

    | Hanning ->
        Array.init length (fun i ->
            0.5 * (1.0 - cos (2.0 * Math.PI * float i / (n - 1.0))))

    | Blackman ->
        Array.init length (fun i ->
            let x = 2.0 * Math.PI * float i / (n - 1.0)
            0.42 - 0.5 * cos x + 0.08 * cos (2.0 * x))

    | BlackmanHarris ->
        Array.init length (fun i ->
            let x = 2.0 * Math.PI * float i / (n - 1.0)
            0.35875 - 0.48829 * cos x + 0.14128 * cos (2.0 * x) - 0.01168 * cos (3.0 * x))

    | Kaiser beta ->
        // Approximate Bessel I0 function
        let besselI0 x =
            let mutable sum = 1.0
            let mutable term = 1.0
            for k in 1 .. 20 do
                term <- term * (x / 2.0 / float k) * (x / 2.0 / float k)
                sum <- sum + term
            sum

        let denominator = besselI0 (Math.PI * beta)
        Array.init length (fun i ->
            let ratio = 2.0 * float i / (n - 1.0) - 1.0
            let arg = Math.PI * beta * sqrt (1.0 - ratio * ratio)
            besselI0 arg / denominator)

/ Resample a block of data
Calls: 2 in this module (ProcessSample, ProcessSample) and 1 in CoreTypes (Phase)
Called by: 2 in FMDemodulator (Create, Process) and 1 in this module (Create)

    member this.Resample(input: float[]) =
        let outputLength = (input.Length * this.InterpolationFactor) / this.DecimationFactor
        let output = Array.zeroCreate outputLength

        let mutable outIdx = 0
        let mutable inIdx = 0
        let mutable phase = this.PhaseAccumulator

        while outIdx < outputLength && inIdx < input.Length do
            // Insert zeros between samples (interpolation)
            if phase % this.InterpolationFactor = 0 then
                ignore (this.Filter.ProcessSample input.[inIdx])
                inIdx <- inIdx + 1
            else
                ignore (this.Filter.ProcessSample 0.0)

            // Output every M samples (decimation)
            if phase % this.DecimationFactor = 0 then
                output.[outIdx] <- this.Filter.ProcessSample 0.0
                outIdx <- outIdx + 1

            phase <- phase + 1
            if phase >= this.InterpolationFactor * this.DecimationFactor then
                phase <- 0

        this.PhaseAccumulator <- phase
        output.[..outIdx-1]

        member _.StartReceive(callback: ComplexSample[] -> unit) =
            match fileStream with
            | None -> Failure "File not open"
            | Some fs ->
                stopRequested <- false
                isStreaming <- true

                let blockSize = 262144  // 128K samples (256KB)
                let buffer = Array.zeroCreate<byte> blockSize

                let threadProc() =
                    try
                        while not stopRequested && fs.Position < fs.Length do

                    finally

    let readWavHeader (reader: BinaryReader) =
        // RIFF header
        let riff = reader.ReadBytes(4)
        if System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetString(riff) <> "RIFF" then
            failwith "Not a valid WAV file"

        let _ = reader.ReadInt32()  // File size
        let wave = reader.ReadBytes(4)
        if System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetString(wave) <> "WAVE" then
            failwith "Not a valid WAVE file"

        // Read chunks until we find 'data'
        let mutable foundData = false
        while not foundData do
            let chunkId = System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetString(reader.ReadBytes(4))
            let chunkSize = reader.ReadInt32()

            match chunkId with
            | "fmt " ->
                let audioFormat = reader.ReadInt16()
                numChannels <- int (reader.ReadInt16())
                sampleRate <- float (reader.ReadInt32()) * 1.0<Hz>
                let _ = reader.ReadInt32()  // Byte rate
                let _ = reader.ReadInt16()  // Block align
                bitsPerSample <- int (reader.ReadInt16())
                // Skip extra format bytes if any
                if chunkSize > 16 then
                    reader.ReadBytes(chunkSize - 16) |> ignore
            | "data" ->
                dataOffset <- reader.BaseStream.Position
                dataLength <- int64 chunkSize
                foundData <- true
            | _ ->
                // Skip unknown chunk
                reader.ReadBytes(chunkSize) |> ignore

        member _.StartReceive(callback: ComplexSample[] -> unit) =
            match binaryReader with
            | None -> Failure "WAV file not open"
            | Some reader ->
                stopRequested <- false
                isStreaming <- true

                let blockSamples = 8192
                let bytesPerSample = bitsPerSample / 8

                let threadProc() =
                    try
                        reader.BaseStream.Seek(dataOffset, SeekOrigin.Begin) |> ignore
                        let mutable bytesRemaining = dataLength

                        while not stopRequested && bytesRemaining > 0L do
                            let samplesToRead = min blockSamples (int (bytesRemaining / int64 bytesPerSample))
                            let samples = Array.zeroCreate<ComplexSample> samplesToRead

                            for i in 0 .. samplesToRead - 1 do
                                let value =
                                    if bitsPerSample = 16 then
                                        float32 (reader.ReadInt16()) / 32768.0f
                                    else
                                        (float32 (reader.ReadByte()) - 128.0f) / 128.0f

                                // WAV is real audio - put in I channel, Q=0
                                samples.[i] <- { I = value; Q = 0.0f }
                                bytesRemaining <- bytesRemaining - int64 bytesPerSample

                            callback samples

                            // Simulate real-time
                            let durationMs = int (1000.0 * float samplesToRead / float sampleRate)
                            Thread.Sleep(max 1 (durationMs / 4))
                    finally
                        isStreaming <- false

                streamThread <- Some (Thread(ThreadStart(threadProc)))
                streamThread.Value.Start()
                Success ()

let rleCompress (data: byte[]) : byte[] =
/ RLE compress image data (following RADARPAS pattern)
Calls: 1 in Compression (decompress) and 1 in Program (Run)

    let rleCompress (data: byte[]) : byte[] =
        let output = ResizeArray<byte>()
        let mutable i = 0

        while i < data.Length do
            let current = data.[i]
            let mutable runLength = 1

            // Count run length
            while i + runLength < data.Length &&
                  data.[i + runLength] = current &&
                  runLength < 255 do
                runLength <- runLength + 1

            if runLength >= 3 || current = 0x00uy || current = 0xFFuy then
                // Use RLE encoding
                output.Add(0xFFuy)  // Escape marker
                output.Add(byte runLength)
                output.Add(current)
            else
                // Output raw bytes
                for _ in 1 .. runLength do
                    if current = 0xFFuy then
                        output.Add(0xFFuy)
                        output.Add(1uy)
                        output.Add(0xFFuy)
                    else
                        output.Add(current)

            i <- i + runLength

        output.ToArray()

    /// RLE decompress

/ Sharpen image using unsharp mask

    let sharpen (data: byte[,]) (amount: float) : byte[,] =
        let height = Array2D.length1 data
        let width = Array2D.length2 data

        // Simple 3x3 blur for unsharp mask
        let blurred = Array2D.zeroCreate height width
        for y in 1 .. height - 2 do

                    int data.[y+1, x-1] + int data.[y+1, x] + int data.[y+1, x+1]
                blurred.[y, x] <- byte (sum / 9)

        // Apply unsharp mask: result = original + amount * (original - blurred)
        Array2D.init height width (fun y x ->
            if y > 0 && y < height - 1 && x > 0 && x < width - 1 then
                let diff = float data.[y, x] - float blurred.[y, x]
                let sharpened = float data.[y, x] + amount * diff
                byte (max 0.0 (min 255.0 sharpened))

member this.Run() =
/ Main loop
Calls: 10 in this module (clearScreen, printHeader, printHelp, printSatelliteInfo, +6 more) and 1 in CoreTypes (Name)
Called by: 1 in ImageReconstructor (rleCompress) and 1 in this module (main)

    member this.Run() =
        Display.clearScreen()
        Display.printHeader()
        Display.printSatelliteInfo currentSatellite
        Display.printHelp()

        let mutable running = true

        while running do
            printf "  > "
            let input = Console.ReadLine()

            if not (String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace input) then
                let parts = input.Trim().Split(' ')
                let cmd = parts.[0].ToLower()

                match cmd with
                | "r" | "receive" ->
                    let useSimulation = parts.Length > 1 && parts.[1] = "sim"
                    this.ReceiveFromSDR(useSimulation)

                | "f" | "file" ->
                    if parts.Length > 1 then
                        this.ProcessWavFile(parts.[1])
                    else
                        printfn "  Usage: file <path.wav>"

                | "p" | "predict" ->
                    this.ShowPassPredictions()

                | "s" | "satellite" ->
                    if parts.Length > 1 then
                        match Int32.TryParse(parts.[1]) with
                        | true, n -> this.SetSatellite(n)
                        | _ -> printfn "  Usage: satellite <15|18|19>"
                    else
                        printfn "  Current: %s" currentSatellite.Name
                        printfn "  Usage: satellite <15|18|19>"

                | "l" | "location" ->
                    if parts.Length >= 4 then
                        match Double.TryParse(parts.[1]), Double.TryParse(parts.[2]), Double.TryParse(parts.[3]) with
                        | (true, lat), (true, lon), (true, alt) ->
                            this.SetLocation(lat, lon, alt)
                        | _ ->
                            printfn "  Usage: location <lat> <lon> <alt_km>"
                    else
                        printfn "  Current: %.4f°, %.4f°, %.1f km"
                            (float groundStation.Latitude)
                            (float groundStation.Longitude)
                            (float groundStation.Altitude)
                        printfn "  Usage: location <lat> <lon> <alt_km>"

                | "o" | "output" ->
                    if parts.Length > 1 then
                        this.SetOutputDirectory(parts.[1])
                    else
                        printfn "  Current: %s" outputDirectory

                | "h" | "help" | "?" ->
                    Display.printHelp()

                | "q" | "quit" | "exit" ->
                    running <- false

                | "" -> ()

                | _ ->
                    printfn "  Unknown command. Type 'help' for commands."

        printfn ""
        printfn "  Goodbye!"

member _.PredictNextPass(propagator: SGP4Propagator, satellite: NOAASatellite, startTime: DateTime) : SatellitePass option =
/ Predict next pass for satellite
Calls: 2 in this module (Propagate, toTopocentric)
Called by: 1 in this module (PredictPasses)

    member _.PredictNextPass(propagator: SGP4Propagator, satellite: NOAASatellite, startTime: DateTime) : SatellitePass option =
        let stepMinutes = 1.0
        let maxSearchMinutes = 1440.0 * 2.0  // Search up to 2 days

        let mutable time = startTime
        let mutable inPass = false
        let mutable aos = DateTime.MinValue
        let mutable maxEl = 0.0<degree>
        let mutable maxElTime = DateTime.MinValue
        let mutable aosAz = 0.0<degree>

        let mutable found = false
        let mutable searchMinutes = 0.0

        while not found && searchMinutes < maxSearchMinutes do
            let eci = propagator.Propagate(time)
            let topo = CoordinateTransform.toTopocentric eci observer time

            if topo.Elevation > minElevation then
                if not inPass then
                    // AOS
                    inPass <- true
                    aos <- time
                    aosAz <- topo.Azimuth
                    maxEl <- topo.Elevation
                    maxElTime <- time

                if topo.Elevation > maxEl then
                    maxEl <- topo.Elevation
                    maxElTime <- time
            else
                if inPass then
                    // LOS - pass complete
                    found <- true

            time <- time.AddMinutes(stepMinutes)
            searchMinutes <- searchMinutes + stepMinutes

        if found then
            let los = time.AddMinutes(-stepMinutes)
            let losEci = propagator.Propagate(los)
            let losTopo = CoordinateTransform.toTopocentric losEci observer los

            Some {
                Satellite = satellite
                AOS = aos
                LOS = los
                MaxElevation = maxEl
                MaxElevationTime = maxElTime
                AzimuthAtAOS = aosAz
                AzimuthAtLOS = losTopo.Azimuth
                Duration = los - aos
            }
        else
            None

    /// Predict multiple passes

def classical_nowcast(seq: StormSequence) -> dict:
Detect the dominant cell in the last two pictures, difference the centroids (the DrawMarkers method) and extrapolate `horizon` frames.
Calls: 3 in this module (detect_cells, features, marker_velocity) and 1 in e300_frames (E300 radar picture model and synthetic storm cell sequences: speed_dir)
Called by: 1 in run_prototype (Run the LSM storm cell analysis prototype end to end: main)

def classical_nowcast(seq: StormSequence) -> dict:
    """Detect the dominant cell in the last two pictures, difference the
    centroids (the DrawMarkers method) and extrapolate `horizon` frames."""
    horizon = seq.labels["horizon"]
    cur = detect_cells(seq.frames[-1])
    prev = detect_cells(seq.frames[-2])
    if not cur:
        return dict(x=np.nan, y=np.nan, vx=0.0, vy=0.0, speed=0.0, direction=0.0,
                    x_future=np.nan, y_future=np.nan, octant=0)
    c = cur[0]
    if prev:  # nearest previous cell to the current dominant one
        p = min(prev, key=lambda d: (d.x - c.x) ** 2 + (d.y - c.y) ** 2)
        vx, vy = marker_velocity(p, c)
    else:
        vx, vy = 0.0, 0.0
    dt_h = horizon * FRAME_MINUTES / 60.0
    spd, ang = speed_dir(vx, vy)
    return dict(x=c.x, y=c.y, vx=vx, vy=vy, speed=spd, direction=ang,
                x_future=c.x + vx * dt_h, y_future=c.y + vy * dt_h,
                octant=int(((ang + 22.5) % 360) // 45))

Called by: 1 in this module (classical_nowcast)

def detect_cells(frame: np.ndarray, min_level: int = 2, min_pixels: int = 60) -> list[DetectedCell]:
    """Connected components of moderate-or-heavier echo, centroids in km."""
    mask = frame >= min_level
    lab, n = ndimage.label(mask)
    cells = []
    if n == 0:
        return cells
    idx = np.arange(1, n + 1)
    sizes = ndimage.sum(mask, lab, idx)
    coms = ndimage.center_of_mass(mask, lab, idx)
    means = ndimage.mean(frame.astype(np.float32), lab, idx)
    for size, (r, c), m in zip(sizes, coms, means):
        if size < min_pixels:
            continue
        cells.append(DetectedCell(x=(c + 0.5) * KM_PER_COL, y=(PIC_H - r - 0.5) * KM_PER_ROW,
                                  area_km2=float(size) * KM_PER_COL * KM_PER_ROW, mean_level=float(m)))
    return sorted(cells, key=lambda d: -d.area_km2 * d.mean_level)

def evaluate(preds: list[dict], seqs: list[StormSequence]) -> dict:
    lab = {k: np.array([s.labels[k] for s in seqs], dtype=float) for k in
           ("x", "y", "speed", "direction", "x_future", "y_future", "octant")}
    prd = {k: np.array([p[k] for p in preds], dtype=float) for k in lab}
    ok = np.isfinite(prd["x"])
    pos = np.hypot(prd["x"] - lab["x"], prd["y"] - lab["y"])
    now = np.hypot(prd["x_future"] - lab["x_future"], prd["y_future"] - lab["y_future"])
    persist = np.hypot(lab["x"] - lab["x_future"], lab["y"] - lab["y_future"])  # "no motion" nowcast
    return dict(
        n=int(len(seqs)), detected=float(ok.mean()),
        position_mae_km=float(np.nanmean(pos)),
        speed_mae_kmh=float(np.nanmean(np.abs(prd["speed"] - lab["speed"]))),
        direction_mae_deg=float(np.nanmean(circular_error(prd["direction"], lab["direction"]))),
        nowcast_mae_km=float(np.nanmean(now)),
        persistence_nowcast_mae_km=float(np.mean(persist)),
        octant_accuracy=float(np.mean(prd["octant"] == lab["octant"])),
    )

def features(self, seq: StormSequence) -> np.ndarray:
liquid state = every neuron's trace (input neurons included, as in Maass's
Calls: 3 in encoding (Spike encoding of E300 picture sequences for the reservoir: encode_sequence, num_inputs, readout_times) and 1 in reservoir (Liquid state machine reservoir: simulate)
Called by: 3 in this module (classical_nowcast, fit, predict)

    def features(self, seq: StormSequence) -> np.ndarray:
        raster = encode_sequence(seq.frames, self.rng, self.steps_per_frame, self.max_rate,
                                 self.onset_channels, self.rf_sigma)
        times = readout_times(seq.frames.shape[0], self.steps_per_frame, self.readout_k)
        r = self.reservoir.simulate(raster, times, count_window=self.steps_per_frame * 2)
        self.spikes_per_seq.append(r["tot_spikes"])
        # liquid state = every neuron's trace (input neurons included, as in Maass's
        # formulation) at each readout time, plus recent spike counts. Each block is
        # L1-normalised per sample so the readout sees an activation *distribution*:
        # a cell's centroid is then linear in the features regardless of its size or
        # intensity, and velocity is the difference between two readout times.
        sl = slice(0 if self.readout_inputs else self.reservoir.num_inputs, self.reservoir.n)
        parts = [r["trace_at"][t][sl] for t in times] + [r["counts"][sl]]
        return np.concatenate([p / (p.sum() + 1e-6) for p in parts])

def marker_velocity(prev: DetectedCell, cur: DetectedCell) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """DrawMarkers' two-marker difference as a velocity in km/h."""
    dt_h = FRAME_MINUTES / 60.0
    return (cur.x - prev.x) / dt_h, (cur.y - prev.y) / dt_h

def make_sequence(rng: np.random.Generator, n_frames: int = 10, n_cells: int | None = None,
Random storm sequence. Labels describe the dominant cell at the last observed frame and its true position `horizon` frames later (the nowcast target).
Calls: 4 in this module (frame_extent_km, render_frame, speed_dir, step)
Called by: 1 in run_prototype (Run the LSM storm cell analysis prototype end to end: main)

def make_sequence(rng: np.random.Generator, n_frames: int = 10, n_cells: int | None = None,
                  horizon: int = 3, max_cells: int = 1) -> StormSequence:
    """Random storm sequence. Labels describe the dominant cell at the last
    observed frame and its true position `horizon` frames later (the nowcast
    target)."""
    wkm, hkm = frame_extent_km()
    n_cells = n_cells or int(rng.integers(1, max_cells + 1))
    speed = rng.uniform(15.0, 70.0)                     # km/h, shared steering flow
    heading = rng.uniform(0.0, 360.0)
    vx0, vy0 = speed * np.sin(np.radians(heading)), speed * np.cos(np.radians(heading))
    cells = []
    for _ in range(n_cells):
        cells.append(StormCell(
            x=rng.uniform(0.2 * wkm, 0.8 * wkm), y=rng.uniform(0.2 * hkm, 0.8 * hkm),
            vx=vx0 + rng.normal(0, 4.0), vy=vy0 + rng.normal(0, 4.0),
            radius=rng.uniform(4.0, 14.0), peak=rng.uniform(0.5, 1.0),
            growth=rng.normal(0.0, 0.03)))
    frames, states = [], []
    total = n_frames + horizon
    for t in range(total):
        states.append([StormCell(**vars(c)) for c in cells])
        if t < n_frames:
            frames.append(render_frame(cells, rng))
        for c in cells:
            c.step(rng)
    dom_idx = max(range(n_cells), key=lambda i: states[n_frames - 1][i].peak * states[n_frames - 1][i].radius ** 2)
    now = states[n_frames - 1][dom_idx]
    fut = states[n_frames - 1 + horizon][dom_idx]
    spd, ang = speed_dir(now.vx, now.vy)
    labels = dict(x=now.x, y=now.y, vx=now.vx, vy=now.vy, speed=spd, direction=ang,
                  x_future=fut.x, y_future=fut.y, n_cells=n_cells, horizon=horizon,
                  octant=int(((ang + 22.5) % 360) // 45))
    return StormSequence(np.stack(frames), states[:n_frames], labels)

def render_frame(cells: list[StormCell], rng: np.random.Generator | None = None,
Quantised E300 picture (PIC_H, PIC_W) for the given cells.
Calls: 1 in this module (frame_extent_km)
Called by: 1 in this module (make_sequence)

def render_frame(cells: list[StormCell], rng: np.random.Generator | None = None,
                 noise: float = 0.02) -> np.ndarray:
    """Quantised E300 picture (PIC_H, PIC_W) for the given cells."""
    wkm, hkm = frame_extent_km()
    xs = (np.arange(PIC_W) + 0.5) * KM_PER_COL
    ys = hkm - (np.arange(PIC_H) + 0.5) * KM_PER_ROW       # row 0 is the top line
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(xs, ys)
    echo = np.zeros((PIC_H, PIC_W), dtype=np.float32)
    for c in cells:
        g = c.peak * np.exp(-((X - c.x) ** 2 + (Y - c.y) ** 2) / (2.0 * c.radius ** 2))
        np.maximum(echo, g, out=echo)
    if rng is not None and noise > 0:
        echo += rng.random(echo.shape).astype(np.float32) * noise
    lvl = np.zeros_like(echo, dtype=np.uint8)
    for k, th in enumerate(LEVEL_THRESH, start=1):
        lvl[echo >= th] = k
    return lvl

def speed_dir(vx: float, vy: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Speed (km/h) and direction of motion in degrees clockwise from north,
    matching the ATan(dX/dY) convention in DrawMarkers."""
    speed = float(np.hypot(vx, vy))
    ang = float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(vx, vy))) % 360.0
    return speed, ang

    def step(self, rng: np.random.Generator, jitter: float = 0.4):
        dt = FRAME_MINUTES / 60.0
        self.x += self.vx * dt + rng.normal(0, jitter) * dt
        self.y += self.vy * dt + rng.normal(0, jitter) * dt
        self.peak = float(np.clip(self.peak + self.growth, 0.05, 1.0))
        self.radius = float(np.clip(self.radius * (1.0 + 0.02 * self.growth * 10), 2.0, 40.0))

def encode_sequence(frames: np.ndarray, rng: np.random.Generator, steps_per_frame: int = 8,
(num_inputs, T) uint8 spike raster for a (n_frames, PIC_H, PIC_W) sequence.
Calls: 2 in this module (num_inputs, receptive_fields) and 1 in e300_frames (E300 radar picture model and synthetic storm cell sequences: pool_frame)
Called by: 1 in analysis (Storm cell analysis: features)

def encode_sequence(frames: np.ndarray, rng: np.random.Generator, steps_per_frame: int = 8,
                    max_rate: float = 0.5, onset_channels: bool = True,
                    rf_sigma: float = 1.5) -> np.ndarray:
    """(num_inputs, T) uint8 spike raster for a (n_frames, PIC_H, PIC_W) sequence."""
    grids = np.stack([receptive_fields(pool_frame(f), rf_sigma) for f in frames])  # (F, GRID_H, GRID_W)
    F = grids.shape[0]
    T = F * steps_per_frame
    rate = grids.reshape(F, -1)                                  # (F, 960)
    out = np.zeros((num_inputs(onset_channels), T), dtype=np.uint8)
    for f in range(F):
        sl = slice(f * steps_per_frame, (f + 1) * steps_per_frame)
        p = np.clip(rate[f] * max_rate, 0.0, 1.0)
        out[:NUM_RATE_INPUTS, sl] = rng.random((NUM_RATE_INPUTS, steps_per_frame)) < p[:, None]
        if onset_channels and f > 0:
            grew = (rate[f] - rate[f - 1]) > 0.08
            out[NUM_RATE_INPUTS:, f * steps_per_frame] = grew
    return out

def readout_times(n_frames: int, steps_per_frame: int, k: int = 4) -> list[int]:
    """Reservoir steps at which the trace is sampled: the end of k pictures spread
    evenly from the first to the last, so the readout sees the cell's displacement
    over the whole sequence (velocity = difference of decoded positions)."""
    frames = sorted({int(round(f)) for f in np.linspace(1, n_frames, k)})
    return [f * steps_per_frame - 1 for f in frames]

def receptive_fields(grid: np.ndarray, sigma: float) -> np.ndarray:
Overlapping Gaussian receptive fields over the pooled picture (population coding): each input neuron responds to echo within ~sigma grid cells of its centre, so a storm drives a graded patch of neurons rather than a few isolated ones and its position is smoothly decodable by a linear readout.
Called by: 1 in this module (encode_sequence)

def receptive_fields(grid: np.ndarray, sigma: float) -> np.ndarray:
    """Overlapping Gaussian receptive fields over the pooled picture (population
    coding): each input neuron responds to echo within ~sigma grid cells of its
    centre, so a storm drives a graded patch of neurons rather than a few
    isolated ones and its position is smoothly decodable by a linear readout."""
    if sigma <= 0:
        return grid
    g = gaussian_filter(grid, sigma=sigma, mode="constant")
    peak = float(g.max())
    return g / peak * float(grid.max()) if peak > 0 else g

def _build_weights(self) -> csr_matrix:
-- simulation
Calls: 1 in this module (watts_strogatz_edges)
Called by: 1 in this module (__init__)

    def _build_weights(self) -> csr_matrix:
        k = max(2, int(round(self.p.presynaptic_degree * self.n)))
        edges = watts_strogatz_edges(self.n, k, self.p.small_world_p, self.rng)
        flip = self.rng.random(edges.shape[0]) < 0.5
        pre = np.where(flip, edges[:, 0], edges[:, 1])
        post = np.where(flip, edges[:, 1], edges[:, 0])
        w = self.rng.normal(self.p.mean_weight, abs(self.p.mean_weight) * self.p.weight_cv,
                            pre.size).astype(np.float32)
        W = csr_matrix((w, (pre, post)), shape=(self.n, self.n), dtype=np.float32)
        W.setdiag(0.0)
        W.eliminate_zeros()
        W.sort_indices()
        return W

    # -- simulation -----------------------------------------------------------

    def liquid_state(self, input_spikes: np.ndarray, readout_times: list[int],
                     count_window: int = 16) -> np.ndarray:
        """Feature vector for a readout: traces at each readout time (hidden
        neurons only) followed by recent spike counts."""
        r = self.simulate(input_spikes, readout_times, count_window)
        hid = slice(self.num_inputs, self.n)
        parts = [r["trace_at"][t][hid] for t in sorted(readout_times)]
        parts.append(r["counts"][hid])
        return np.concatenate(parts)

def simulate(self, input_spikes: np.ndarray, readout_times: list[int] | None = None,
Run the reservoir on input_spikes (num_inputs, T) of 0/1. Returns dict(spikes=(T, N) int8, trace_at={t: trace vector}, counts=(N,) spike counts over the last count_window steps, tot_spikes=int). The membrane potentials are reset to the same initial state for every call, as in Freddi's MEMBRANE_RESET
Calls: 2 in encoding (Spike encoding of E300 picture sequences for the reservoir: num_inputs, readout_times)
Called by: 1 in analysis (Storm cell analysis: features) and 1 in this module (liquid_state)

    def simulate(self, input_spikes: np.ndarray, readout_times: list[int] | None = None,
                 count_window: int = 16) -> dict:
        """Run the reservoir on input_spikes (num_inputs, T) of 0/1.

        Returns dict(spikes=(T, N) int8, trace_at={t: trace vector}, counts=(N,)
        spike counts over the last count_window steps, tot_spikes=int). The
        membrane potentials are reset to the same initial state for every call,
        as in Freddi's MEMBRANE_RESET=true setting."""
        inp = np.asarray(input_spikes)
        if inp.ndim != 2 or inp.shape[0] != self.num_inputs:
            raise ValueError(f"input_spikes must be ({self.num_inputs}, T)")
        T = inp.shape[1]
        N, Nin = self.n, self.num_inputs
        thr = np.float32(self.p.membrane_threshold)
        amp = np.float32(self.p.current_amplitude)
        refr_len = self.p.refractory_period + 1
        readout_times = set(readout_times or [T - 1])

        mem = self.mem0.copy()
        refr = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int32)
        trace = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.float32)
        spikes = np.zeros((T, N), dtype=np.int8)
        trace_at = {}
        tot = 0
        for t in range(T):
            np.maximum(refr - 1, 0, out=refr)
            mem[:Nin] += amp * inp[:, t]
            firing = (mem >= thr) & (refr == 0)
            spikes[t] = firing
            tot += int(firing.sum())
            trace *= self.trace_decay
            trace[firing] += 1.0
            mem[firing] = 0.0
            refr[firing] = refr_len
            mem *= self.leak_factor
            if tot:
                mem += self.WT @ firing.astype(np.float32)
            if t in readout_times:
                trace_at[t] = trace.copy()
        counts = spikes[max(0, T - count_window):].sum(axis=0).astype(np.float32)
        return dict(spikes=spikes, trace_at=trace_at, counts=counts, tot_spikes=tot)

def watts_strogatz_edges(n: int, k: int, p: float, rng: np.random.Generator) -> np.ndarray:
Undirected edge list (m, 2) of a Watts-Strogatz ring lattice with rewiring. Each node links to its k/2 nearest neighbours on each side of the ring; every edge is then rewired to a uniformly random non-self target with probability p (duplicates are dropped).
Calls: 1 in encoding (Spike encoding of E300 picture sequences for the reservoir: num_inputs)
Called by: 1 in this module (_build_weights)

def watts_strogatz_edges(n: int, k: int, p: float, rng: np.random.Generator) -> np.ndarray:
    """Undirected edge list (m, 2) of a Watts-Strogatz ring lattice with rewiring.

    Each node links to its k/2 nearest neighbours on each side of the ring; every
    edge is then rewired to a uniformly random non-self target with probability p
    (duplicates are dropped)."""
    k = max(2, int(k) // 2 * 2)
    src = np.repeat(np.arange(n), k // 2)
    off = np.tile(np.arange(1, k // 2 + 1), n)
    dst = (src + off) % n
    rewire = rng.random(src.size) < p
    dst = dst.copy()
    dst[rewire] = rng.integers(0, n, rewire.sum())
    keep = src != dst
    edges = np.stack([src[keep], dst[keep]], axis=1)
    lo, hi = edges.min(axis=1), edges.max(axis=1)
    return np.unique(np.stack([lo, hi], axis=1), axis=0)

calls_summary: 2 in this module (Average, WriteRadial)
text:
RADARPAS / GRAPH / RadarInt (x86 Assembly asm)
RadarInt    PROC NEAR
Procedure called by an interrupt from the data acquisition board.
Calls: 2 in this module (Average, WriteRadial)
Called by: 1 in this module (Average)

RadarInt    PROC NEAR
; Procedure called by an interrupt from the data acquisition board.
; Stores three returns and then processes and writes the data.
            CALL Average
            CALL WriteRadial
            MOV Step,AX
            INC AX
            CMP AX,MaxStep
            MOV AX,Step

RadarInt    ENDP

name: GRAPH.WriteRadial
description: Averages the three returns stored by RadarInt, storing the averaged
text:
RADARPAS / GRAPH / WriteRadial (x86 Assembly asm)
WriteRadial PROC NEAR
Averages the three returns stored by RadarInt, storing the averaged
Called by: 1 in this module (RadarInt)

WriteRadial PROC NEAR
; Writes the current radial, using the data in AvgRed and AvgGrn.
; If SweepOn<>0, then erases the sweep line on the white plane.
WriteRadial ENDP

name: GRAPH.WriteSweep
description: Writes the current radial, using the data in AvgRed and AvgGrn.
text:
RADARPAS / GRAPH / WriteSweep (x86 Assembly asm)
WriteSweep  PROC NEAR
Writes the current radial, using the data in AvgRed and AvgGrn.

WriteSweep  PROC NEAR
; If SweepOn<>0, then writes the sweep line on the white plane.
; Regardless of SweepOn, erases the data under the current radial.
WriteSweep  ENDP



PROCEDURE ARINC429Interrupt;

(* Sends control information to RS-811A via ARINC 429 bus.
 * Called by clock timer interrupt, 18 times per second.

VAR

BEGIN

  (* Adjust Mode, Tilt, Gain, and Range values *)

  (* Set parity bit *)
  (* Send control word 1 *)

  ControlWord := ControlWord2 + Range << RangeVal +
                 CARDINAL(MaintReq) << MaintReqShift;
  MaintReq := ~ MaintReq;
  (* Set parity bit *)
  (* Send control word 2 *)

  (* Ensure data is being received via ARINC 453 *)

END ARINC429Interrupt;



(* ARINC 453 Data Word Format:
 *
 *          BITS     FIELD      COMMENTS
 *          ==================================
 *           0 -  7  LABEL      = 055C
 *           8 - 17  RESERVED   = 0000000011B
 *               18  RESERVED
 *               19  FAULT      Display fault
 *               20  FAULT      Calibration fault
 *               21  FAULT      Altitude input fault
 *               22  FAULT      Control fault
 *               23  FAULT      Antenna fault
 *               24  FAULT      R/T fault
 *               25  RESERVED   = 0B
 *          26 - 28  MODE       000B = Standby
 *                              001B = Weather only
 *                              010B = Map only
 *                              100B = Test
 *          29 - 35  TILT       Degrees*4
 *          36 - 41  GAIN       000000B = max, 111111B = min
 *          42 - 47  RANGE      Miles/5
 *          48 - 50  RESERVED   = 011B
 *          51 - 62  AZIMUTH    4096 steps per 360 degrees
 *                              (0.08789 degrees per step)
 *               63  RESERVED
 *        64 - 1599  WEATHER DATA
 *
 *
 * ARINC 453 Maintenance Word Format
 *
 *          BITS     FIELD      COMMENTS
 *          ==================================
 *           0 -  7  LABEL      = 170C
 *           8 -  9  RESERVED   = 11B
 *               10  MAINT      Elevation fault
 *               11  MAINT      400 Hz reference fault
 *               12  MAINT      Gyro input fault
 *               13  MAINT      HV fault
 *               14  MAINT      AFC fault
 *               15  MAINT      AGC fault
 *               16  MAINT      Transmitter inhibited
 *               17  MAINT      Not used
 *          18 - 21  REV CODE   0 = A, 1 = B, etc.
 *          22 - 28  400 HZ REF ANGLE
 *          29 - 35  ANT ELEV   Degrees*2 (from feedback pot in R/T)
 *          36 - 50  RESERVED   = 000000000000000B
 *          51 - 62  AZIMUTH    4096 steps per 360 degrees
 *                              (0.08789 degrees per step)
 *               63  RESERVED
 *        64 - 1599  WEATHER DATA
 *)

BEGIN

 *     Set ant elev value

RADARPAS / Serial / OnEvent (Modula-2 procedure)
PROCEDURE OnEvent(ComPort : CARDINAL;
Initializes the specified serial port to the parameters indicated.
Calls: 1 in Sets (Incl)

PROCEDURE OnEvent(ComPort   : CARDINAL;
                  Event     : EventCode;
                  DoProc    : PROC);
BEGIN
  WITH Com[ComPort] DO
    CASE Event OF
      dataReady      : INCL(IntMask,0)
|     overrunError,
      parityError,
      framingError,
      breakInterrupt : INCL(IntMask,1)
|     bufferEmpty    : INCL(IntMask,2)
|     deltaCTS,
      deltaDSR,
      deltaRI,
      deltaCD        : INCL(IntMask,3)
    END; (* CASE *)
    OUTBYTE(IOAddress+1,CARDINAL(IntMask));
    EventHandler[Event]:=DoProc;
  END; (* WITH *)
END OnEvent;

description: Set up return stack | also: SWEEP2-2 (1989-1989), SWEEP2 (1989-1989), SWEEP3 (1989-1989), SWEEP4 (1989-1989)
calls_summary: 1 in Sweep (Current radar data in use: Quad1)
text:
RADARPAS / SWEEP / BEGIN (x86 Assembly asm)
BEGIN     PROC FAR
Set up return stack
Calls: 1 in Sweep (Current radar data in use: Quad1)

BEGIN     PROC FAR
          PUSH DS                       ; Set up return stack
          XOR AX,AX
          PUSH AX
          MOV AX,DataSeg                ; Set up DS segment register
          MOV DS,AX
          MOV ES,AX                     ; Set up ES segment register

          ; Set hires (640x350) mode
          MOV AX,0010H     
          INT 10H     
          ; Set read and write modes 0
          MOV DX,3CEH                   ; Port[3CEH] = 05H  
          MOV AL,05H  
          OUT DX,AL     
          MOV DX,3CFH                   ; Port[3CFH] = 00000000B     
          MOV AL,00000000B
          OUT DX,AL     
          ; Set function 00H
          MOV DX,3CEH                   ; Port[3CEH] = 03H     
          MOV AL,03H     
          OUT DX,AL     
          MOV DX,3CFH                   ; Port[3CFH] = 00000000B     
          MOV AL,00000000B     
          OUT DX,AL
     
          ; Set the color palette
          MOV BX,00H                    ; Load counter     
CLoop:    MOV DX,3DAH                   ; Reset EGA attribute controller
          IN AL,DX                      ;   flip-flop     
          MOV DX,3C0H                   ; Load palette address
          MOV AL,BL     
          OUT DX,AL     
          MOV AL,[BX+OFFSET Palette]    ; Load palette value
          OUT DX,AL
          INC BX     
          CMP BX,10H  
          JNE CLoop     
          MOV DX,3DAH     
          IN AL,DX
          MOV DX,3C0H     
          MOV AL,00100000B     
          OUT DX,AL     
     
     
          XOR AX,AX                     ; Set up CurrInc to be -CurrDir
          SUB AX,CurrDir     
          MOV CurrInc,AX
     
          MOV CurrDraw,OFFSET Quad1
     
Loop:     MOV AX,CurrDraw     
          CALL AX     
          MOV AH,06H
          MOV DL,0FFH
          INT 21H
          JZ Loop
          RET
     
BEGIN     ENDP  
     
Center    = 14040D
CentBit   = 16
CentMask  = 01111111B

name: FIMENU.NewLog
description: Checks if all pointers for a given log number are cleared, indicating the log is available for reuse. Works with internal data structure Log array. Returns true if no active pointers exist.
text:
SSM / FIMENU / NewLog (Turbo Pascal function)
FUNCTION NewLog(LogNumber : INTEGER) : BOOLEAN;
Checks if all pointers for a given log number are cleared, indicating the log is available for reuse. Works with internal data structure Log array. Returns true if no active pointers exist.
Called by: 1 in this module (CloseLog)

FUNCTION NewLog(LogNumber : INTEGER) : BOOLEAN;

  BEGIN
    WITH Log[LogNumber] DO
      NewLog:=
        (Pointer[TRt]=0) AND
        (Pointer[Deliveryt]=0) AND
        (Pointer[DLMFIt]=0) AND
        (Pointer[MMPt]=0) AND
        (Pointer[Pricet]=0);
  END;

name: Node.NodeSize

calls_summary: 1 in Sheet (List)
text:
SSM / Node / NodeSize (Modula-2 procedure)
PROCEDURE NodeSize(ForNode : NodeRec) : CARDINAL;
Returns size in bytes of a node's data structure for memory management. Works with internal node records containing symbols, strings, numbers, lists, and subroutines.
Calls: 1 in Sheet (List)
Called by: 1 in this module (MakeNode)

PROCEDURE NodeSize(ForNode : NodeRec) : CARDINAL;
BEGIN
  CASE ForNode.Type OF
    Symbol  : RETURN 6+Length(ForNode.StrV); |
    String  : RETURN 2+Length(ForNode.StrV); |
    Integer : RETURN 4; |
    Real    : RETURN 10; |
    List    : RETURN 2+ForNode.MaxElement*4; |
    Subr,
    FSubr   : RETURN 10;
  END; (* CASE *)
END NodeSize;

text:
SSM / UTILITY2 / CompareDates (Turbo Pascal function)
function CompareDates(Date1, Date2 : DateRec) : integer;
SubDates
Called by: 1 in AXTRANS (AddTrans), 1 in BACKUP (InitRestore) and 1 in IAMENU (MatchLog)

function CompareDates(Date1, Date2  : DateRec)  : integer;
begin   if (Date1.Year = Date2.Year) then
            if (Date1.Month = Date2.Month) then
                if (Date1.Day = Date2.Day) then
                    if (Date1.Hour = Date2.Hour) then
                        CompareDates := Date1.Minute - Date2.Minute
                    else
                        CompareDates := Date1.Hour - Date2.Hour
                else
                    CompareDates := Date1.Day - Date2.Day
            else
                CompareDates := Date1.Month - Date2.Month
        else
            CompareDates := Date1.Year - Date2.Year;
end (* CompareDates *);
